instruction: A fern clump: many overlapping arching fronds radiating from a central base, each frond a stem lined with many small leaflets, spread in a slightly chaotic natural fan. Varied lengths, fresh green.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a fern clump. A fern clump: many overlapping arching fronds radiating from a central base, each frond a stem lined with many small leaflets, spread in a slightly chaotic natural fan. Varied lengths, fresh green. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
